title: UneceStandard
description:
A referenced norm or requirement that establishes uniform criteria, methods, processes and practices, such as in
engineering or technical areas.

agencyId.description: The identifier of the agency for this referenced standard.

applicableAssessment.description: A specified assessment applicable to this referenced standard.

applicableCountry.description: A country where this referenced standard is applicable.

applicableDeclaration.description: A specified declaration applicable to this referenced standard.

applicableLicence.description: A specified licence applicable to this referenced standard.

applicableMetricCharacteristic.description: A metric characteristic applicable to this referenced standard.

applicableSpecifiedCertificate.description: A specified certificate applicable to this referenced standard.

attachedBinaryFile.description: A binary file attached to this referenced standard.

description.description: A textual description of this referenced standard.

elementVersionId.description:
The identifier of the version of a specific element within the referenced standard, such as the version of a data
element.

identifier.description: The identifier of this referenced standard.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this referenced standard.

partId.description: The identifier of a part of this referenced standard, such as a section or topic.

specifiedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion specified for this referenced standard.

specifiedDocument.description: A referenced document specified for this referenced standard.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of referenced standard.

uRIId.description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for this referenced standard.

versionId.description: The identifier of the version of this referenced standard.
